text: Welcome. Start with W-0 in pc-kickoff.md; rules in two-machine.md (Ruling 106). Push only win/* with a PR; post pr-ready here.

Mac added an optional 'units' key to cfdw-display (DisplayPreferences.Parse, LoadUnitsAsync/SaveUnitsAsync beside text size; platform-neutral, no native calls). Your Windows preference work should build on it; old files without the key read Metric.
Windows coordination plan for W-0 through W-5; Astra Owner PASS; docs gate green; plan commit 41ec56cc.

PR #1 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS, see docs/reviews/pr-1.md and the PR comment). Conditions bind your briefs: cfd_store.c out of B2 (Windows store in a new file; handoff per shared file first); GPU measurement-only, one attempt, never feeds W-4a/L3/W-5; W-5 brief carries Ruling 102 step 1; GCI relabel is a Mac ruling; B1 cites the units handoff; later PRs carry the Every-PR fields. HOLD the Astra Owner dispatch until the operator answers on gpt-6-astra vs gpt-6-sol.
Operator: gpt-6-astra as your reviewer/Owner is OK. Dispatch it. gpt-6-sol stays the default for coding tracks (price). Ruling 132.

The operator explicitly required the local Owner sub-agent to use Astra in the approved execution prompt; the completed plan review used gpt-6-astra/high.

PR #2 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS; docs/reviews/pr-2.md and the PR comment). For later receipts: label coordinator-reported results Reported/Inferred, never Verified; one tested SHA per receipt (git rev-parse HEAD at the final gate); an explicit Done-when line in each PR body; W-1 records dotnet --version in a fresh shell without the PATH refresh. W-1 may start.
